title: Desktop sweep: remove hardcoded INR, en-IN and Asia/Kolkata from pages and components
goal: Make every screen use the agency's currency, date format and time zone instead of India's.
why: Audit 02 counted 178 en-IN, 93 INR, 39 ₹, 14 Asia/Kolkata and 62 +91 lines across desktop/src; after R202 the helpers are locale-aware but pages still pass literals.
steps: grep -rn "en-IN\|'INR'\|"INR"\|₹\|Asia/Kolkata\|+91" desktop/src/app desktop/src/components; for each hit: currency formatting -> formatCurrency(amount, doc.currency) or the store default; dates -> formatDisplayDate; time zones -> the store; currency pickers default to the tenant currency; "+91" defaults -> tenant phoneDefaultCountry (PhoneInput gets it in R204; here only remove literal +91 defaults by reading the store).
Keep India-only features India-only by condition, not by deletion: GSTIN, HSN/SAC, UPI fields show when tax_system is gst or country is IN.

locale.spec.ts (multi slot, two agencies created through the admin API helper from R121): agency UK (GBP, en-GB, Europe/London) and agency IN; the dashboard, an invoice and a payment show £ and dd/mm/yyyy for UK and ₹ with lakh grouping for IN.
Work in folders, one at a time (dashboard, leads, contacts, itineraries, invoices/payments/credit-notes, reports, fleet, settings, components); run lint-gate after each folder.
acceptance: The grep above returns only India-conditional code paths and tests (list them in the report).
Full e2e suite green on slot 0 (Indian demo).
gate: cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failing files, passed >= last merged count (1294 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3100 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8787/api/v1 npx playwright test
cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3110 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8797/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/locale.spec.ts
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).

Desktop UI follows desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md (ds-* tokens, archetypes, FilterBar + infinite scroll, RelationCombobox, PhoneInput, useConfirm, graceful degradation). lint-gate must not rise for any touched file.

Large mechanical sweep: if it will not fit in one sitting, stop after a complete set of folders, leave the tree green and report which folders remain; the orchestrator re-runs this batch for the rest.
